A small shop outside Chicago

WindyCityWares is based in Schaumburg, Illinois, in the Chicago suburbs. We hand-pick everything we sell: handcrafted pieces with the maker’s touch, antiques and vintage finds with a history of their own, gifts and home décor, and memorial urns with artwork chosen to honor a loved one.

Every order is packed carefully so it arrives in one piece, and real people are here to answer your questions.
